From 1260c3845f54502a05a87594f09a334786bb34d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Ulises=20Gasc=C3=B3n?= <ulisesgascongonzalez@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:08:39 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fix: prevent process crash from trailing bytes after a
 compressed body

Ref: https://github.com/expressjs/body-parser/security/advisories/GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828

Co-authored-by: Gavin Stuart <46635587+blue2cat@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Sebastian Beltran <bjohansebas@gmail.com>
---
 lib/read.js  |  34 +++++++--
 test/json.js | 201 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 227 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/lib/read.js b/lib/read.js
index fce6283f..5252e293 100644
--- a/lib/read.js
+++ b/lib/read.js
@@ -51,6 +51,15 @@ function read (req, res, next, parse, debug, options) {
     : null
   var verify = opts.verify
 
+  // assert charset is supported before creating the decompression stream, so a
+  // 415 cannot leave a decoder piped with no error listener
+  if (verify && encoding !== null && !iconv.encodingExists(encoding)) {
+    return next(createError(415, 'unsupported charset "' + encoding.toUpperCase() + '"', {
+      charset: encoding.toLowerCase(),
+      type: 'charset.unsupported'
+    }))
+  }
+
   try {
     // get the content stream
     stream = contentstream(req, debug, opts.inflate)
@@ -66,14 +75,6 @@ function read (req, res, next, parse, debug, options) {
     ? null
     : encoding
 
-  // assert charset is supported
-  if (opts.encoding === null && encoding !== null && !iconv.encodingExists(encoding)) {
-    return next(createError(415, 'unsupported charset "' + encoding.toUpperCase() + '"', {
-      charset: encoding.toLowerCase(),
-      type: 'charset.unsupported'
-    }))
-  }
-
   // read body
   debug('read body')
   getBody(stream, opts, function (error, body) {
@@ -104,6 +105,23 @@ function read (req, res, next, parse, debug, options) {
       return
     }
 
+    // detach and destroy the decompression stream to avoid
+    // decompression errors on the finished stream
+    if (stream !== req) {
+      // only detach the decompression stream, keep other consumers piped
+      if (typeof req.unpipe === 'function') {
+        req.unpipe(stream)
+      } else {
+        // Node.js 0.8 streams have no unpipe(dest)
+        unpipe(req)
+      }
+      stream.on('error', function () {})
+      destroy(stream, true)
+
+      // consume any remaining bytes so the HTTP request can finish
+      req.resume()
+    }
+
     // verify
     if (verify) {
       try {
diff --git a/test/json.js b/test/json.js
index cca9e223..4ed5cbb0 100644
--- a/test/json.js
+++ b/test/json.js
@@ -2,7 +2,9 @@
 var assert = require('assert')
 var asyncHooks = tryRequire('async_hooks')
 var Buffer = require('safe-buffer').Buffer
+var crypto = require('crypto')
 var http = require('http')
+var onFinished = require('on-finished')
 var request = require('supertest')
 
 var bodyParser = require('..')
@@ -11,6 +13,18 @@ var describeAsyncHooks = typeof asyncHooks.AsyncLocalStorage === 'function'
   ? describe
   : describe.skip
 
+// Since Node.js 11 zlib ends the readable side of a decompression stream as
+// soon as the compressed frame is complete (Z_STREAM_END). Older versions keep
+// the decoder open until the request ends, so the parser can never finish
+// before the request does and trailing bytes are reported as a decode error.
+var zlibEndsAtStreamEnd = parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0], 10) >= 11
+var itZlibEndsAtStreamEnd = zlibEndsAtStreamEnd ? it : it.skip
+
+// zlib.deflateSync('{"a":1}') and zlib.gzipSync('{"a":1}'), precomputed because
+// the sync zlib API only exists since Node.js 0.12
+var DEFLATED_JSON = Buffer.from('789cab564a54b232ac0500082a0209', 'hex')
+var GZIPPED_JSON = Buffer.from('1f8b0800000000000003ab564a54b232ac0500afac1b5607000000', 'hex')
+
 describe('bodyParser.json()', function () {
   it('should parse JSON', function (done) {
     request(createServer())
@@ -234,6 +248,193 @@ describe('bodyParser.json()', function () {
     })
   })
 
+  // @see https://github.com/expressjs/body-parser/security/advisories/GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828
+  // Uses a raw socket (not supertest) so the trailing bytes reach the decoder
+  // after it has finished the valid frame, which is what triggers the crash.
+  describe('with trailing bytes after a compressed body', function () {
+    itZlibEndsAtStreamEnd('should finish the request when the decompressor finishes early', function (done) {
+      var jsonParser = bodyParser.json()
+      var client
+      var server = createServer(function (req, res, next) {
+        jsonParser(req, res, function (err) {
+          if (err) return next(err)
+          // downstream middleware waits for the entire HTTP request to finish
+          onFinished(req, next)
+          // ensure the last bytes arrive after the decompressor has finished
+          client.end(trailing)
+        })
+      })
+      var first = Buffer.concat([
+        DEFLATED_JSON,
+        Buffer.from([0x00])
+      ])
+      var trailing = Buffer.alloc(1024)
+
+      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', function () {
+        client = http.request({
+          host: '127.0.0.1',
+          port: server.address().port,
+          method: 'POST',
+          path: '/',
+          agent: false,
+          headers: {
+            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+            'Content-Encoding': 'deflate',
+            'Content-Length': first.length + trailing.length
+          }
+        }, function (res) {
+          var data = ''
+          res.setEncoding('utf8')
+          res.on('data', function (c) { data += c })
+          res.on('end', function () {
+            server.close()
+            assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
+            assert.strictEqual(data, '{"a":1}')
+            done()
+          })
+        })
+        client.on('error', done)
+        client.setTimeout(1000, function () {
+          client.destroy(new Error('Timed out waiting for the HTTP request to finish'))
+        })
+        client.write(first)
+      })
+    })
+
+    itZlibEndsAtStreamEnd('should preserve other consumers of the request body', function (done) {
+      var jsonParser = bodyParser.json()
+      var client
+      var server = createServer(function (req, res, next) {
+        // a second consumer hashes the raw request body, e.g. for an audit log
+        var hash = crypto.createHash('sha256')
+        req.pipe(hash)
+
+        jsonParser(req, res, function (err) {
+          if (err) return next(err)
+          hash.once('finish', function () {
+            res.setHeader('X-Body-SHA256', hash.read().toString('hex'))
+            next()
+          })
+          // ensure the last bytes arrive after the decompressor has finished
+          client.end(trailing)
+        })
+      })
+      var first = Buffer.concat([
+        DEFLATED_JSON,
+        Buffer.from([0x00])
+      ])
+      var trailing = Buffer.alloc(1024)
+      var expectedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(first).update(trailing).digest('hex')
+
+      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', function () {
+        client = http.request({
+          host: '127.0.0.1',
+          port: server.address().port,
+          method: 'POST',
+          path: '/',
+          agent: false,
+          headers: {
+            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+            'Content-Encoding': 'deflate',
+            'Content-Length': first.length + trailing.length
+          }
+        }, function (res) {
+          var data = ''
+          res.setEncoding('utf8')
+          res.on('data', function (c) { data += c })
+          res.on('end', function () {
+            server.close()
+            assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
+            assert.strictEqual(data, '{"a":1}')
+            assert.strictEqual(res.headers['x-body-sha256'], expectedHash)
+            done()
+          })
+        })
+        client.on('error', done)
+        client.setTimeout(1000, function () {
+          client.destroy(new Error('Timed out waiting for the request body hash'))
+        })
+        client.write(first)
+      })
+    })
+
+    it('should not crash on trailing bytes after a gzip body', function (done) {
+      var server = createServer()
+      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', function () {
+        var port = server.address().port
+        var body = Buffer.concat([
+          GZIPPED_JSON,
+          Buffer.from([0x00]),
+          Buffer.alloc(100 * 1024, 0x58)
+        ])
+        var req = http.request({
+          host: '127.0.0.1',
+          port: port,
+          method: 'POST',
+          path: '/',
+          headers: {
+            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+            'Content-Encoding': 'gzip',
+            'Content-Length': body.length
+          }
+        }, function (res) {
+          var data = ''
+          res.on('data', function (c) { data += c })
+          res.on('end', function () {
+            setTimeout(function () {
+              server.close()
+              if (zlibEndsAtStreamEnd) {
+                assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
+                assert.strictEqual(data, '{"a":1}')
+              } else {
+                // older zlib keeps decoding the trailing bytes: depending on the
+                // version they are ignored (200) or reported as invalid (400)
+                assert.ok(res.statusCode === 200 || res.statusCode === 400, 'unexpected status ' + res.statusCode)
+              }
+              done()
+            }, 200)
+          })
+        })
+        req.on('error', done)
+        req.end(body)
+      })
+    })
+
+    it('should not crash when an unsupported charset rejects a compressed body', function (done) {
+      var server = createServer({ verify: function () {} })
+      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', function () {
+        var port = server.address().port
+        var body = Buffer.concat([
+          GZIPPED_JSON,
+          Buffer.from([0x00]),
+          Buffer.alloc(100 * 1024, 0x58)
+        ])
+        var req = http.request({
+          host: '127.0.0.1',
+          port: port,
+          method: 'POST',
+          path: '/',
+          headers: {
+            'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-999',
+            'Content-Encoding': 'gzip',
+            'Content-Length': body.length
+          }
+        }, function (res) {
+          res.on('data', function () {})
+          res.on('end', function () {
+            setTimeout(function () {
+              server.close()
+              assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 415)
+              done()
+            }, 200)
+          })
+        })
+        req.on('error', done)
+        req.end(body)
+      })
+    })
+  })
+
   describe('with inflate option', function () {
     describe('when false', function () {
       before(function () {
